session_summary: A medical session discussing Mrs. Georgescu's diabetes management and foot wound. The doctor referred her to surgery and outlined follow-up tests and care instructions.

proposed_actions.title: Book Surgery Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Doctor will call to arrange an appointment for the outpatient clinic of the county hospital.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I will take care of the appointment, I'll call you tomorrow morning.

proposed_actions.title: Prepare Weekly Pill Box
proposed_actions.description: Ana will prepare a weekly pill box for Mrs. Georgescu on Sunday evening.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Ana, please prepare it for her on Sunday evening for the whole week.

proposed_actions.title: Buy Medication from Pharmacy
proposed_actions.description: Ana will buy the weekly pill box from the pharmacy today.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Sure, I will buy it from the pharmacy today.

proposed_actions.title: Inform Community Assistant
proposed_actions.description: Doctor will inform the community assistant, Mrs. Ioana, to visit on Monday afternoon.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I will inform the community assistant, Mrs. Ioana, to visit you on Monday afternoon.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Lab Tests
proposed_actions.description: Doctor will schedule glycosylated hemoglobin and urine tests at the lab until Friday.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I also want a glycosylated hemoglobin and a urine test. You do them at the lab until Friday.

proposed_actions.title: Reschedule Lab Tests
proposed_actions.description: Doctor will reschedule the lab tests to Thursday due to availability.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: We will do them on Thursday, because I have free time.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Follow-Up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Doctor will schedule a follow-up appointment on November 20th at eleven o'clock.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Come back on November 20th at eleven o'clock with the results and with the medical letter from the surgeon.

proposed_actions.title: Write Down Appointment Date
proposed_actions.description: Ana will write down the appointment date for Mrs. Georgescu.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Ana, please write it down, please. I noted.

decisions: Doctor referred Mrs. Georgescu to the outpatient clinic of the county hospital.
Lab tests will be scheduled for Thursday.
risks: If fever appears or the foot swells, Mrs. Georgescu should come immediately.
follow_up_questions: Who will ensure the community assistant visits on Monday afternoon?
Is there a specific pharmacy Ana should use for the weekly pill box?
